# Dragoon's Town 0.27 release notes

## More life around each purchase

- Restoring an original business or permanent district venture now finishes with a small opening celebration.
- Expanding an already restored location can show a short handcart delivery with visitors and parcels.
- Low town activity keeps the scene lighter; Full adds a second visitor and parcel detail.

## Comfort and compatibility

- Street moments follow the existing Off/Low/Full and Life pause controls.
- Reduced motion, battery saver, app/background pauses and district switches stop the new motion.
- The overlays are decorative, cannot capture taps and add no saved progress.
- Existing saves, prices, income, prestige, artwork, Android package and original signing identity remain compatible.
- Real payments and ads remain disabled.

Browser and compatible Android publication will follow only after the complete cloud, viewport, mobile-touch, package and signature checks pass. Physical Android 13/Thor testing remains separate and is not claimed by automated verification.

AI-assisted development with OpenAI Codex.
